U_tip.note: Frozen W3 baseline (2026-07-26): real Abaqus 2021 solve, element type C3D20R (Standard, quadratic reduced-integration hex), producing run_id dd6ec1145b8de62f. Euler-Bernoulli PL^3/3EI = 1.9048e-3 mm; measured deviates 0.04% from theory. -1 N U2 load at tip-center node.

MISES_MAX.note: Frozen W3 baseline (2026-07-26): unaveraged ELEMENT_NODAL Mises max from the same C3D20R solve, producing run_id dd6ec1145b8de62f. Extrapolated to element corner nodes and NOT averaged across elements, which is what post/extract_kpis.py requests for any MISES field_max. An integration-point max, or a nodal-averaged one, is a different number; do not compare either against this baseline.
